authority: No profile, plan or PlanCertificate grants execution authority.

rules.requirement: Select an explicit package-supported profile; do not infer it from untrusted source or plan fields.
The closed descriptor must match its package-pinned RFC 8785 SHA-256 digest.
Plan profileId, profileVersion and profileDigest must exactly equal the selected descriptor binding. The verifier emits the same binding into its PlanCertificate.
The change contains exactly one delta at the selected path; all predicate evaluations receive that same path.
The selected semanticType, explicit Unknown states, source coherence, frozen roots, evidence, ordering and zero-effect ceiling use the existing shared relation.

verificationCommand: oac verify SNAPSHOT CHANGE PLAN --profile PROFILE
